blockingFindings.title: Duplicate Phase Assertion
blockingFindings.issue: The draft repair target checkpoint replay test asserts `producedArtifact.phase === "draft-questions"` twice in succession, so one assertion is redundant and does not add behavioral coverage.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Remove one duplicate `assert.equal(producedArtifact.phase, "draft-questions")` assertion from the draft repair target checkpoint replay test.
blockingFindings.rationale: This is an observable maintainability issue in a touched test file, but the remaining assertion still verifies the required phase behavior, so no mandatory requirement or blocking guardrail requires repair.
